name: Dev Tools
description: A lightweight dev toolset under 200KB — instant to use. Sandboxed and offline with zero network access. High-frequency tools for crypto, encoding, text, data conversion, formatting, time, networking and image generation; inputs and options are remembered and sync seamlessly across devices via DBX.
releaseNotes: 修复：Cron 的 N/step 步长解析（如 0/2 不再退化为整点），非法 ?/N 会被拒绝。新增：下次执行条数可自定义并记忆；首页 GitHub 图标加入动画（空闲微摆 + 悬停变色），页脚新增开源反馈入口，复制链接改为跟随点击位置的浮层提示。 | Fix: cron N/step atoms (e.g. 0/2) no longer degrade to the bare start value, and invalid ?/N is rejected. New: configurable next-runs count (persisted); animated GitHub icon with idle tail-flick and brand-teal hover, plus a footer invite for issues/PRs/stars; copy confirmation is now a floating chip at the click point.

zh-CN.name: Dev 工具集
zh-CN.description: 不到 200KB 的轻量开发者工具集，即开即用。沙箱离线运行，零网络权限。涵盖加解密、编解码、文本处理、数据转换、格式化、时间计算、网络运维、图像生成等众多高频工具；参数自动记忆，配置可随 DBX 跨端无缝同步。
